mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.quantity),0) FROM ( SELECT l.quantity FROM wm_stock_document d JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.document_id=d.id JOIN wm_stock_action a ON a.id=l.stock_action_id AND a.document_line_id=l.id AND a.execution_id=d.source_execution_id WHERE d.source_execution_id=#{executionId} AND d.status=#{posted} AND d.document_type IN (#{receipt},#{productionReceipt}) UNION ALL SELECT quantity_delta FROM mes_warehouse_acceptance WHERE execution_id=#{executionId} ) f
